string.name: title
string.value: 1. The Start of Adventure

string.name: text
string.value:
突然，
力量充满了你的血管，
你的攻击开始有了效果。
这是女神的祝福。

string.name: text
string.value: And so, your adventure began.

string.name: title
string.value: 2. 非常不像探险家的女孩

string.name: text
string.value: 在探索维多利亚岛时，\n你遇到了一个名叫Sugar的女孩。\n

string.name: text
string.value: She was headed for Ellinia to take her Job Advancement test, but her fear of bugs got in her way.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text
string.value: 女神透露她是居住在枫树中的冒险岛的精神。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她感觉到世界正处于危险之中，\n于是派出了她的另一个自我Sugar来守护。\n

string.name: title
string.value: 3. 被偷走的宝石

string.name: text
string.value: 当你听到新闻快讯时，\n你正在适应新生活：一颗属于冒险家公会的重要宝石被一个戴面具的小偷偷走了！

string.name: text
string.value: Athena Pierce requested your help in retrieving it, which is how you ended up chasing the thief up and down the outskirts of Henesys. When you finally stopped the thief and got the jewel, an Explorer named Olive appeared.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text
string.value: 女神透露她是居住在枫树中的冒险岛的精神。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她感觉到世界正处于危险之中，\n于是派出了她的另一个自我Sugar来守护。\n

string.name: title
string.value: 4. 真正的罪魁祸首

string.name: text
string.value: 你前往Ereve寻找Olive和封印石。\n

string.name: text
string.value: When you confronted her, Olive adamantly denied having anything to do with the Seal Stone. She blamed someone called the 'Master of Disguise.'

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text
string.value: 女神透露她是居住在枫树中的冒险岛的精神。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她感觉到世界正处于危险之中，\n于是派出了她的另一个自我Sugar来守护。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她说那片枫叶已经成为冒险岛的封印石，\n由你朋友们想要拯救岛屿的愿望所形成。\n

string.name: title
string.value: 5. 伪装大师

string.name: text
string.value: 根据你最新的线索，\n你终于觉得自己在拼凑这个谜题的碎片。\n

string.name: text
string.value: Sugar, Tess, Rondo, and Olive met you at the El Nath Crystal Passageway to pursue the Master of Disguise.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text
string.value: 女神透露她是居住在枫树中的冒险岛的精神。\n

string.name: text

string.name: text
string.value: 她说那片枫叶已经成为冒险岛的封印石，\n由你朋友们想要拯救岛屿的愿望所形成。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 利用它的力量，\n你将冒险岛恢复到了原来的样子。\n

string.name: title
string.value: 6. 破碎的封印

string.name: text
string.value:
你检查了各个城镇，
以确保冒险岛为黑魔法师的潜在回归做好准备，
在这个过程中，
你发现现在之门已经打开。

string.name: text
string.value: You ventured through the gate, and at the end of a long corridor... you encountered the Black Mage himself. Upon further investigation, you discovered that one of his seals had broken.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: title
string.value: 7. 冒险岛灾难

string.name: text
string.value:
你还没从震惊中恢复过来，
Sugar就联系了你，
恳求你回到冒险岛。
当你走下渡轮时，
你看到你亲爱的岛屿正笼罩在火焰中。

string.name: text
string.value: Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text

string.name: title
string.value: 8. 战士英雄Aran

string.name: text
string.value:
你的任务是去找Aran谈谈，
所以你访问了 Rien岛，
在那里Lilin连珠炮式地问你问题，
试探你的意图。

string.name: text
string.value: In the midst of Lilin's quizzes, Aran appeared. But he had amnesia and could remember nothing of use.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text

string.name: text

string.name: title
string.value: 9. 黑暗回归

string.name: text
string.value: 即使没有封印石，\n你知道自己不能放弃冒险岛。\n

string.name: text
string.value: As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

string.name: text
string.value: 利用它的力量，\n你将冒险岛恢复到了原来的样子。\n

string.name: title
string.value: 10. 新的封印石

string.name: text
string.value: 你着迷地看着那片枫叶变成了一颗宝石。\n

string.name: text
string.value: Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text

string.name: text
string.value: 利用它的力量，\n你将冒险岛恢复到了原来的样子。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 然后，\n你与朋友们拥抱告别。\n

string.name: text
string.value:
于是这个故事落幕了，
但其他故事还有待开始。
更多的冒险等待着那些有意志去寻找它们的人。

string.name: title
string.value: 1. 冒险的开始

string.name: text
string.value:
这一切始于一棵树，
一棵枫树。
当你离开它温暖的怀抱时，
你感觉到一场超越你最疯狂梦想的冒险即将来临。
一片枫叶拂过你的鞋子，
你把它夹进你的冒险家手册中，
作为你起源的提醒。

string.name: text
string.value: And so, your adventure began.

string.name: text

string.value: 8. 最终英雄Luminous

string.name: text
string.value: 你的任务是去找Luminous，\n所以你去魔法密林边缘的森林寻找他。\n

string.name: text
string.value: You stumbled upon a robot, which seemed out of place. It called you an intruder, so you fought it, thinking it had to be evil.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text
string.value: 女神透露她是居住在枫树中的冒险岛的精神。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她感觉到世界正处于危险之中，\n于是派出了她的另一个自我Sugar来守护。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她说那片枫叶已经成为冒险岛的封印石，\n由你朋友们想要拯救岛屿的愿望所形成。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 利用它的力量，\n你将冒险岛恢复到了原来的样子。\n

string.name: title
string.value: 9. 黑暗回归

string.name: text
string.value: 即使没有封印石，\n你知道自己不能放弃冒险岛。\n

string.name: text
string.value: As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: title
string.value: 10. 新的封印石

string.name: text
string.value: 你着迷地看着那片枫叶变成了一颗宝石。\n

string.name: text
string.value: Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

string.name: text
string.value:
你用尽了一切，
最终，
你消灭了黑暗。

string.name: text
string.value: 女神透露她是居住在枫树中的冒险岛的精神。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她感觉到世界正处于危险之中，\n于是派出了她的另一个自我Sugar来守护。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 她说那片枫叶已经成为冒险岛的封印石，\n由你朋友们想要拯救岛屿的愿望所形成。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 利用它的力量，\n你将冒险岛恢复到了原来的样子。\n

string.name: text
string.value: 然后，\n你与朋友们拥抱告别。\n

string.name: text
string.value:
于是这个故事落幕了，
但其他故事还有待开始。
更多的冒险等待着那些有意志去寻找它们的人。
